Description

So.. i guess what happened was VRChat did not like me changing my mouse DPI setting on the fly (by the button on the mouse) to make me go spin, and thus removed me from my own session. When attempting to rejoin my friends it only sent me to default home world instead. It would not allow me to do anything else. But thre is nothing listed against my account so i restarted the game.

Reproduction Steps

not sure. My guess is me changing my dpi mouse settings is the way to reproduce said issue until it disconnects you from the session for unusual behavior.
